# permitio_resource (Resource)

Manages a resource: a type of object that your application protects, such as a document, with the actions users can take on it and the attributes that policies can check. See [the documentation](https://api.permit.io/v2/redoc#tag/Resources/operation/create_resource) for more information about resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    permitio = {
      source = "permitio/permit-io"
    }
  }
}

resource "permitio_resource" "document" {
  key         = "document"
  name        = "Document"
  description = "A document in the document store"
  actions = {
    read = {
      name = "Read"
    }
    write = {
      name        = "Write"
      description = "Create or change a document"
    }
    delete = {
      name = "Delete"
    }
  }
  attributes = {
    owner = {
      type        = "string"
      description = "The key of the user who owns the document"
    }
    classified = {
      type = "bool"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes Map) The actions users can take on the resource, by action key, such as `read`. A top-level role grants one as the permission `resource_key:action_key`, and a role on this resource as the action key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `key` (String) A URL-friendly name of the resource (i.e: slug). You will be able to query later using this key instead of the id (UUID) of the resource. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `name` (String) The name of the resource

### Optional

- `attributes` (Attributes Map) Attributes that each resource of this type defines, and can be used in your ABAC policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes))
- `description` (String) An optional longer description of what this resource represents in your system. Leaving it out keeps the description the resource has in Permit.
- `urn` (String) The URN (Uniform Resource Name) of the resource

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `environment_id` (String) Unique id of the environment that owns the resource
- `id` (String) Unique id of the resource
- `organization_id` (String) Unique id of the organization that owns the resource
- `project_id` (String) Unique id of the project that owns the resource
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the action.

Optional:

- `description` (String) A description of the action.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID Permit assigns to the action.


<a id="nestedatt--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes`

Required:

- `type` (String) The type of the attribute: `bool`, `number`, `string`, `time`, `array` or `json`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) A description of the attribute.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import a resource by its key.
# An imported resource with no attributes has none in the state, so if the
# configuration sets attributes = {}, the first plan after the import adds it in
# place. Applying that plan changes nothing in Permit.
terraform import permitio_resource.example document
```
